summary: Frontend-only validation of the restructured MoodMap phase modal for all 5 phases (Menstrual, Follicular, Ovulation, Luteal, PMS). Logged in as testuser@test.com, seeded onboarding + partner profile localStorage, opened each phase via legend buttons, and verified the new modal layout end-to-end: title (name + Days range), punchline, Play-by-Play paragraph, What She Feels (Physical + Mental/Emotional columns), and both collapsible sections (Prep, Action). Verified default-collapsed state, independent expand/collapse behavior, bullet counts (Prep=4 for all; Action=4 except Follicular=5), and chevron rotation.
critical_code_review_comments: CollapsibleSection sets max-height from scrollHeight computed once on mount; if inner content changes dynamically (e.g., text wrap due to viewport resize) after open, height may become stale. Not blocking for current static content.
seed_data_creation: None persisted server-side. Set localStorage: cyclecoach_state_waiver_complete_<uid>=true, cyclecoach_consent_granted_<uid>=true, cyclecoach_partner_profile_<uid>=<base64 profile with cycleStartDate = today-10d, averageCycleLength=28>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 phase modals verified against new restructured layout. Playwright script fills login via placeholders (name attributes are not present); use data-testid='login-submit-btn' to disambiguate from nav 'Log In'. To reach dashboard, seed the three localStorage keys for user id 0c6935cc-7225-4de3-ab2b-143fc07deace, then navigate to /. Collapsible content is a sibling div of the button with inline style.maxHeight ('0px' when collapsed).
